summary: Tillamook County lookout: a 30-foot pole L-4 tower built in 1936 and removed or destroyed around 1948; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 30-foot pole L-4 tower with a 14x14 cab (Forest Lookouts describes it as a round timber tower)
facts.status_note: Removed around 1948 per the register; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1948
facts.agency: Oregon Dept. of Forestry (register and firelookout.com); Siuslaw National Forest per Forest Lookouts

events.note: Panorama photographs taken at the site on March 20, 1934, per Forest Lookouts
30-foot tower raised; the house was not yet built in December 1936
Panorama photographs taken at the site on May 28, 1937, per Forest Lookouts
Register says removed around 1948; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1948; Forest Lookouts gives c.1948 for removal
Date registered November 16, 2010 on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register

evidence.supports: built in 1936 as a 30-foot pole L-4 tower; removed around 1948
evidence.quote: Built in 1936, this 30' pole L-4 tower was removed around 1948.

evidence.supports: firelookout.com gives 30-foot pole L-4 tower, 1936, destroyed 1948
a 30-foot round timber tower with a 14x14 cab was constructed in 1936
evidence.quote: 1936: A 30-foot round timber tower with a 14x14 cab constructed.

evidence.supports: December 1936: tower raised, house not yet constructed
evidence.quote: At Square Top the tower has been raised but the house has not yet been constructed.

evidence.supports: c.1948 removal of the lookout tower
register names the Oregon Dept. of Forestry as administering agency
firelookout.com names the Oregon Dept. of Forestry
Forest Lookouts places the site in the Siuslaw National Forest
Square Top is in Tillamook County and listed as a gone tower
evidence.quote: Square Top Tillamook 45.29800 -123.63507 Tower Gone FFLOS US 739, OR 148

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com name the Oregon Dept. of Forestry; Forest Lookouts names the Siuslaw National Forest and gives the location as 3S-8W-23. The story reports both and does not choose.
The register says removed around 1948; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1948; Forest Lookouts says removed about 1948. All three agree on the date and differ on the word.

sources.title: Square Top Lookout Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites (Forest Fire Lookout Association)

notes_for_editor: Agency conflicts: the brief and register say Oregon Dept. of Forestry, while Forest Lookouts says Siuslaw NF. The brief's height_m 9.1 matches the 30-foot tower. No staffing information was found in any source, so staffing is omitted. No source describes remains or public access.
